notes.title: Director’s Letter: Update Notice for Poker Royale Difficulty Adjustments
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing All in Abyss: Judge the Fake.
Based on player feedback, we have made adjustments and improvements to Poker Royale mode.

[b]<<Poker Royale Adjustments>>[/b]
- The number of consecutive wins required to fully complete each difficulty has been adjusted as follows:
  - Jack Class: 5 → 3
  - Queen Class: 10 → 5
  - King Class: 20 → 7
  - Ace Class: 50 → 10
  - Joker Class: 99 → 15

- BB amounts across all difficulties have been reduced.
  This is aimed at reducing unintended player losses due to high BB values.

- The amount of SP earned per floor has been increased for all difficulties.
  While the total SP earned for completing the league is reduced due to fewer floors,
  SP efficiency per play time has improved.


- Player starting chips have been adjusted as follows:
  - Jack Class: 200,000 → 500,000
  - Queen Class: No changes except BB amount and win count
  - King Class: 5,000,000 → 2,000,000
  - Ace Class: 30,000,000 → 5,000,000
  - Joker Class: 50,000,000 → 10,000,000

- Enemy starting chips have also been adjusted per difficulty.

- The amount of “Special Fragments” remains unchanged.
  However, total money earned from completing the league is reduced, though all difficulties now guarantee earnings above the entry fee.

- Other minor bug fixes have been implemented.


The above updates will be implemented in the Nintendo Switch version at a later date.
Thank you for your continued support of All in Abyss: Judge the Fake.

notes.title: Director’s Letter: Upcoming Poker Royale Update Notice
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing All in Abyss: Judge the Fake.
We plan to release an update that overhauls Poker Royale at around 23:00 (PDT) on April 23, 2025.
To make Poker Royale more enjoyable, we will reduce the number of win-streaks required for completing the league on every difficulty and adjust the overall balance.

New win-streak requirements
・Jack Class: 5 → 3
・Queen Class: 10 → 5
・King Class: 20 → 7
・Ace Class: 50 → 10
・Joker Class: 99 → 15
Because the number of rounds is being reduced, the total SP awarded for completing the league will decrease, but SP earned per unit of play time will increase.

If you apply the update while using a save that was mid-game (Take a Break) during Poker Royale, the following will occur once (only the first time you resume). Subsequent play data will not be affected. If you wish to finish your current run under the pre-update rules, please do so before applying the patch.

――――――
<What happens when updating with a mid-game save>

[b]1.	When you resume Poker Royale after the update, the round count displayed will be the pre-update value.[/b]

Example: If you take a break at 49 wins in Joker Class (showing 50F/99F), the same 50F/99F will appear on resuming. Because Joker Class now requires 15 wins, you will immediately face the final (15th) enemy. Defeating it completes Joker Class. Any “Special Fragments” obtained before the update will remain and can be exchanged after victory.

[b]2.	The player’s initial chip count remains at the pre-update value.[/b]
Due to adjustments to the number of rounds, the initial chip amounts for both players and enemies have been changed. However, if you resume the game from suspended data saved before the update, the chip amounts will remain as they were prior to the update and will not reflect the new values.
　*Please note that this will not result in any disadvantage to the player.

Example: Ace Class initial chips change from 5,000,000 → 2,000,000. If you resume from pre-update data holding 5,000,000 chips, you will still have 5,000,000. 
 *This does not disadvantage the player.
――――――

The Nintendo Switch™ version will receive this update at a later date.
Thank you for your continued support of All in Abyss: Judge the Fake.

notes.title: Director’s Letter：New Update: Game Balance and Skill Adjustments
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing All in Abyss: Judge the Fake.
We’ve implemented several updates and adjustments based on feedback received from everyone.
This update focuses on reducing stress in certain battles and adventure scenes by making skills easier to use and improving overall game balance.
Whether you’re currently playing or took a break from the game, we invite you to take this opportunity to step back into the world of All in Abyss.



[b]《Updates》[/b]

[b]■ Balancing certain witch battles[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033453/dfe5b7c4dc34dd194ca11f0a8e19a6a859a189cc.png[/img]
Some of the witch battles were found to be taking longer than intended, so adjustments have been made to allow for quicker battle.
Combined with the skill adjustments described below, these changes should make it easier to bring witch battles to an end.


[b]■Adventure Scene Adjustments[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033453/9206e0c40200ccc1cb37d6bb38a9e14a09a2425d.png[/img]
In certain scenes where repeated money-grinding was required, the amount of money earned has been adjusted. This change makes it easier to break free from continuous grinding.


[b]■ Skill Adjustments[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033453/d24db32e3c1a1986871198b2ed25d5b2509ff236.png[/img]
We’ve adjusted the balance of several skills that felt difficult to use due to high Luck Costs or register costs. Below are the details of the changes made:

[b]・Sharp Eye[/b]
register Cost changed from 2 → 1. Same adjustment for the enhanced version, Sharp Eye+.

[b]・Card Counting[/b]
Luck Cost changed from 2 → 1. Same adjustment for Card Counting+.

[b]・Iron Will[/b]
register Cost changed from 3 → 1. Same adjustment for Iron Will+.
Damage reduction effect has been changed as follows:
Iron Will: 50% → 66%
Iron Will+: 75% → 80%

[b]・Luck of the Draw[/b]
register Cost changed from 4 → 3. Same adjustment for Luck of the Draw+.

[b]・Numbers Game[/b]
register Cost changed from 5 → 4. Same adjustment for Numbers Game+.
Luck Cost has also been adjusted as follows:
Numbers Game: 8 → 6
Numbers Game+: 7 → 5

[b]・Ace in the Hole+[/b]
Luck Cost changed from 6 → 5.
(No changes to the base Ace in the Hole skill.)
Additionally, in non-Japanese languages, we have removed the phrase equivalent to *Can only be used when there are 4 cards on the field.
(This is because, once upgraded, the skill can be used regardless of whether there are 4 cards on the field—but the text did not properly reflect this behavior.)

[b]・Deep Breaths[/b]
register Cost changed from 5 → 4. Same adjustment for Deep Breaths+.

[b]・Hand Boost Skills (e.g., [Hand Type] Boost)[/b]
Adjustments were made to improve growth curves and early-level skill power. As a result, overall effectiveness has been raised. Final-tier effects remain unchanged.


[b]■Poker Royale UI Improvements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033453/3b563c6003eee4e9d4cc5da61581cc74f8992824.png[/img]
The visibility of the “Take a Break” and “Skills” buttons on the Poker Royale battle prep screen has been improved.


[b]■Skill UI Improvements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033453/cf762260ffe075946f9c01358f2437ecb2d8ec48.png[/img]
A skill button has been added to the world map screen for easier access to the skill menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033453/554cbc9566e7ff80a2d6ef5517e893276d658540.png[/img]
Additionally, before entering a witch battle, players can now open the skill menu and view hint text suggesting effective skills for the upcoming opponent.


[b]■FOLD Action UI Update[/b]
When attempting to FOLD, your current chip count will now remain visible.
The actual chip loss (equal to the damage shown in the bottom-right of the screen) will only occur once the FOLD is executed.
Previously, chip count would update preemptively to reflect the damage, which caused confusion due to discrepancies between displayed and actual damage. This update resolves that issue.


[b]■Minor Bug Fixes[/b]
Miscellaneous minor bug fixes have been applied.


These update contents are scheduled to be implemented in the Nintendo Switch version at a later date.
We hope you continue to enjoy All in Abyss: Judge the Fake.

notes.title: Demo Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you for your continued support of All in Abyss: Judge the Fake.[/b]

We’ve just updated the demo to [b]Ver.0.80[/b] and released it for everyone to enjoy. This update is based on feedback from our previous demo players, focusing on enhanced gameplay and accessibility. We hope you’ll give this new and improved version a try!

[b]Key Features in the Demo Update[/b]
[list] [*][b]Major Overhaul of the Poker Battle Skill System[/b]
We’ve introduced a [b]Skill Point[/b] system, allowing you to acquire new skills and strengthen your poker hands by spending skill points. You can equip these skills in your skill list to boost your abilities in battle. Construct your own strategies by balancing costs and power!

[*][b]Grand Opening of “club ALL OUT”[/b]
A new pleasure district area is now accessible, where you can spend your hard-earned gambling money. By splurging at “club ALL OUT,” you can raise the maximum [b]“Luck”[/b] needed for skill activation and earn extra skill points. The more you spend, the more advantages you’ll have in your next poker battle—so make sure to have some fun before a big match!

[*][b]New “Poker Royale” Mode[/b]
For those who want to immerse themselves in poker battles, we’ve added a new mode where you can fight consecutive battles against multiple opponents. This mode is separate from the main scenario but offers various difficulty levels and exclusive rewards you won’t find anywhere else. Challenge your limits and climb the ranks as a true gambler!

[*][b]Revised Scenario Text[/b]
[*][b]Updated UI Design and Layout[/b]
[*][b]Various Minor Bug Fixes[/b]
[/list]

[b]We Value Your Feedback[/b]
Please note that the demo still contains content under development. We welcome your feedback on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2514640/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url].

Your insights help us make the game even better! Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Director Message: Regarding the Demo Version
notes.notes:
We have received a large number of reviews of people enjoying All in Abyss: Judge the Fake and deeply appreciate them!

Based on the valuable feedback we've received, we are currently working on further improvements and developments. As part of this effort, we plan to release an update for the demo soon, adding features that improve playability and offering a more satisfying experience. There won't be changes to story progression, but we are addressing the feedback to make the "strategies against the boss" easier and simpler to understand by making adjustments to the progression to make it more enjoyable.

Additionally, we've heard that the judgement scenes lack effects in All in Abyss, so we're planning to add new effects and text to make them more engaging and aesthetically pleasing. We're also implementing a variety of other improvements to make the game more exciting.

It's going to take a bit more time until the full version, so please enjoy the demo version in the mean time!

■ Key improvements planned for the demo version update

・Skill Gain/Enhance Screen and Skill Editing Feature
In the demo version, skills are gained via purchases, but we're making it so that skills can be gained and enhanced from points earned in poker battles. We also plan for players to not only use the strongest skills, but to consider the point costs to enjoy editing their skills strategically.

・All-Out Feature
We're adding a new "All-Out" feature, where you can spend the money from gambling to indulge in lavish spending. The more you spend during your outing, the more benefits you'll receive for your next poker battle. Be sure to treat yourself!
  
・Poker Royale Feature
This is new content to enjoy consecutive poker battles with many opponents. It's separate from the main storyline, but it's recommended for those who are purely focused on poker. There will be multiple difficulties in Poker Royale and multiple clear awards that come along with them.

・Scenario Text Adjustments
・UI Design and Layout Adjustments
・Minor Bug Fixes

notes.title: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake Set to Release on April 10, 2025, in Five Languages
notes.notes:
